 Houston weather: Latest Halloween rain chance timing
 Scattered showers and a few storms are possible on Halloween, and it will be a close call as to whether or not they move out of the area just in time for trick-or-treating. FOX 26 meteorologist Remeisha Shade shares the latest timing as of Wednesday evening.
